# external media

Small "easter egg" clips that punctuate the page. Everything the site
references is declared in **`js/media.js`** - that is the only file you edit to
add, swap or remove one.

## folders

| folder | for |
| ------ | --- |
| `reactions/` | short reaction/atmosphere loops |
| `tmnt/` | artwork for the gift chapter |
| `surron/` | bike artwork, incl. configurator layers |
| `hookah/` | hookah chapter material |
| `diving/` | underwater material |
| `textures/` | grain, paper, halftone overlays |
| `gifs/` | staging area for GIFs before conversion |

## what ships today

Three loops in `reactions/`, generated by `tools/build-external.sh` from ffmpeg
noise and maths. No third-party material:

| file | where it appears | size |
| ---- | ---------------- | ---- |
| `static.mp4` | 2024, under "архив повреждён" | 60 KB |
| `glitch.mp4` | 2025, at ERROR 404 | 36 KB |
| `pulse.mp4` | statistics, when 60+ ТРАВМ is opened | 16 KB |

Regenerate with:

```bash
bash tools/build-external.sh
```

## adding your own

Drop the file in the right folder, then point a slot at it in `js/media.js`:

```js
'game-win': { kind: 'video', src: '/assets/external/reactions/win.mp4', label: '' },
```

Slots set to `null` render nothing at all. A slot pointing at a file that does
not exist also renders nothing - the element removes itself on error - so a
half-finished mapping never leaves a broken-image box on the page.

Currently empty and waiting: `archive-2022`, `game-win`, `game-lose`,
`tmnt-hero`, `tmnt-armor`.

## convert GIFs before using them

**Do not commit a `.gif`.** A GIF is capped at 256 colours and is decoded frame
by frame on the CPU. The same clip as MP4 is typically 5-10x smaller, keeps full
colour, and is decoded by dedicated video hardware, which also means it does not
flatten a phone battery.

```bash
ffmpeg -i in.gif -vf "scale=480:-2" -c:v libx264 -crf 32 -preset slow \
       -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an out.mp4
```

`js/media.js` handles `kind: 'video'` and `kind: 'image'`. Prefer video.

## licensing - read before adding anything

**This site is public.** Files here are served to anyone who opens the page, and
anything committed stays in git history permanently even if deleted later.

That rules out saving reaction GIFs from GIPHY or Tenor and TMNT stills from a
search: those are someone else's work, and re-hosting them publicly is
redistribution, not private use. GitHub does act on DMCA notices against Pages
sites.

What is fine:

- footage and photographs you took
- material you generated (`tools/build-external.sh` output)
- work under a licence that permits reuse and redistribution

Record what you add and where it came from:

| file | source | licence |
| ---- | ------ | ------- |
| `reactions/static.mp4` | generated, `tools/build-external.sh` | own work |
| `reactions/glitch.mp4` | generated, `tools/build-external.sh` | own work |
| `reactions/pulse.mp4` | generated, `tools/build-external.sh` | own work |
